intro.headline: Experience is built, not handed.
intro.description: No job title on a business card yet. What exists instead are years of shipping things that actually work — platforms that beat 55+ teams in competitions, research that earned an IEEE publication, and code that powers real, running systems. This timeline is where it all lives.

timeline.title: IEEE Published Researcher
timeline.description: Co-authored and published a deep learning research paper on vehicle detection and multi-camera route tracking from CCTV images. Presented at IEEE TENSYMP, an international conference.

timeline.title: 1st Runner-Up — Software Engineering Project Show
timeline.description: Built DirectEdge — an AI-powered agricultural supply chain platform with demand forecasting and computer vision — and placed 1st Runner-Up out of 55 competing teams.

timeline.title: Double Champion — CSE Project Show
timeline.description: Won two Champion titles in one semester with Kairos: Project Category (DBMS) and Poster Presentation, defeating 71 competing teams across both tracks.

timeline.title: Undergraduate Researcher & Developer
timeline.description: Studying CSE with hands-on focus — building full-stack platforms, publishing AI research, and competing in project shows every semester. CGPA: 3.61 / 4.00.

cta: Currently open to internships and collaborative opportunities in AI/ML and software development.
